options.content:
### ARO HCP SLI / SLO metrics

Live Grafana companion to the `sli-slo-metrics` report and its charts. The dashboard time picker defines the lookback window for summary and detail panels. The default is 14 days.

**Create SLO:** 95% successful cluster creates and cluster installs complete within 20 minutes.

**Collection model:** these panels use the backend's current-operation gauges and include terminal operations whose latest transition falls inside the selected lookback. The four trend panels use a 24-hour display window and one-hour query step because Azure Managed Prometheus rejects the equivalent multi-day range queries at its query-cost limit. They can miss completed creates after a later operation changes the resource's labels. The generated report remains authoritative for start-time-bounded, deduplicated historical cohorts.

**Datasource selection:** choose `All` for fleet totals or fleet averages across all regional `Managed_Prometheus_services-<region>` datasources, or select one datasource for a regional view. Control-plane version panels use the separate `Managed_Prometheus_hcps-<region>` datasource selector.

**Known gaps:** normalized failure reasons require Kusto, and customer incident counts require IcM/Kusto. Those report sections are intentionally not synthesized from Prometheus.

panels.description: Fleet-weighted cluster create success rate in the selected lookback window.
panels.title: Cluster Create Success Rate

panels.description: Fleet cluster create p95 in minutes for successful current operations whose latest transition falls in the selected window.
panels.title: Cluster Create p95

panels.description: Failed cluster create resources observed during the selected window. Prometheus can miss failures that retry between samples.
panels.title: Cluster Create Failures

panels.description: Current non-terminal cluster create operations whose elapsed time from operation start exceeds the 20-minute install SLO.
panels.title: Current Install SLO Breaches (>20m)

panels.description: Selected-window create outcomes by resource type. This mirrors the Create Health report section.
panels.title: Create Outcomes by Resource Type

panels.description: Fleet create duration percentiles by resource type for successful current operations whose latest transition falls in the selected window.
panels.title: Create Duration p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Fleet-total cluster creates whose latest terminal transition falls within the dashboard time window. Each bar is the total for the selected window, not an hourly count.
panels.title: ARO HCP - Cluster Installs in Selected Window

panels.description: Fleet-total NodePool creates whose latest terminal transition falls within the dashboard time window. Each bar is the total for the selected window, not an hourly count.
panels.title: ARO HCP - NodePool Installs in Selected Window

panels.description: Average regional terminal success rates across the selected datasources for the dashboard time window. The published cluster-create SLO is 95%.
panels.title: ARO HCP - Selected-Window Success Rate

panels.description: Average regional p50 and p95 successful create durations across the selected datasources for the dashboard time window. Cluster p95 is compared with the 20-minute install SLO.
panels.title: ARO HCP - Selected-Window Install Time

panels.description: Terminal current-operation outcomes whose latest transition falls in the selected lookback. This is the live companion to the report's create, delete, and update health sections.
panels.title: ARO HCP - Per-Operation Outcomes

panels.description: Current operation inventory by resource type and phase.
panels.title: Current Operations by Phase

panels.description: Current non-terminal cluster create operations grouped by install SLO severity. Counts are cumulative: the >7d series is included in >24h and >20m.
panels.title: Install SLO Breach Severity

panels.description: Resource-level view of current cluster create operations over the 20-minute install SLO.
panels.title: Install SLO Breach Details

panels.description: Install version observed for clusters in the service-cluster backend metrics.
panels.title: ARO HCP - Install Version of Clusters

panels.description: Current ClusterVersion distribution from HCP management-cluster Prometheus datasources. This source is sparse and only includes HCPs actively reporting the metric.
panels.title: ARO HCP - Control Plane Version Distribution

list.description: Pipe-separated subscription IDs to exclude from the report, such as internal test subscriptions. Keep ^$ to include all subscriptions.
list.label: Exclude Subscriptions
